whatsNew.dialog.title: What’s new in Cmdr

@whatsNew.dialog.title.description: Title of the post-update dialog that summarizes recent changelog entries. The apostrophe is a curly typographic apostrophe (U+2019), not a straight one. Cmdr is the app name; keep it.

whatsNew.dialog.empty: Nothing to see here yet. New changes will show up here after an update.

@whatsNew.dialog.empty.description: Empty-state message in the What's new dialog when there are no changelog entries to show (reachable only via manual reopen).

whatsNew.securityNotice.title: This version fixed {count, plural, one {a security issue} other {# security issues}}.

@whatsNew.securityNotice.title.description: Short notice at the top of the post-update What's new dialog when the versions installed since the user last saw the dialog fixed one or more security vulnerabilities. Past tense: the fix is already running. Calm and factual, not alarming. {count} is how many; the singular form says "a security issue" rather than a numeral. Sentence case.

placeholders.count: how many security issues the new versions fixed, 1 or more

@whatsNew.securityNotice.readAdvisory.description: Link under the security notice in the What's new dialog that opens the public security advisory (on GitHub or the Cmdr website) for the one fixed vulnerability. A short link label, not a sentence. Same wording as updates.toast.readAdvisory.

@whatsNew.securityNotice.readAdvisoryNam.description: One link per fixed vulnerability under the security notice in the What's new dialog, used when there are several, so each link says which advisory it opens. A short link label, not a sentence.

placeholders.id: the advisory's identifier, never translated: a GitHub advisory ID like GHSA-abcd-1234-efgh, or a date-based ID like 2026-10-16-smb-path

@whatsNew.dialog.showMore.description: Button in the What's new dialog that expands one release's detailed change lists (Added, Changed, Fixed), which are collapsed by default.

@whatsNew.dialog.showLess.description: Button in the What's new dialog that collapses one release's detailed change lists again. The expanded counterpart of whatsNew.dialog.showMore.
@whatsNew.dialog.showLess.screenshotNote: The What’s new dialog, pictured here. Your string is the link that folds a release’s detailed changes away again once someone has expanded them.

@whatsNew.dialog.seeFullChangelog.description: Link in the What's new dialog that opens the full online changelog in the browser.

@whatsNew.dialog.optOut.description: Button in the What's new dialog that turns off the post-update changelog popup for good.

@whatsNew.dialog.close.description: Button that closes the What's new dialog.

whatsNew.optOutToast: Got it, no more update notes. Re-enable them anytime in Settings > Updates & privacy.

@whatsNew.optOutToast.description: Confirmation toast after the user opts out of the post-update changelog popup, noting where to turn it back on. Settings > Updates & privacy is a navigation path; keep the menu/section names as shown.
